heading: Mini-intensives, at home.
intro: Intensive therapy is backed by research showing kids tend to make significant gains in just a few short, focused weeks. Mini-intensives run in your child’s most natural environment: home. We travel to you.

boxes.title: Why intensives?
points: Consistent language models and therapy that’s focused on short-term goals.
Daily in-home sessions let therapists understand and use your day-to-day flow, in therapy and in parent coaching.

boxes.title: What’s unique about our model?
points: Therapists with current, working knowledge of AAC and neurodiversity-affirming therapy.
An individualized, affirming, strengths- and interests-based, child-led model.
Unrestricted access to AAC and sensory functioning supports.
Parent and caregiver education and coaching are a priority.
We stay up to date on best practice.
